scoring_justification: Recompute λ and ω_log from the agent's α²F(ω) data; compare Tc to paper's Table III with generous tolerances. T1 feasible because all quantities are arithmetic from raw artifacts.

hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from paper: TaB₂ 0.79, VB₂ 0.28, NbB₂ 0.67, TiB₂ 0.10, YB₂ 0.46.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's reported quantities, traceable to Table III.

schema.notes: Each array pair must be of equal length. The checker will recompute λ and ω_log from these arrays and compare against hidden paper values.

outputs.description: Raw isotropic Eliashberg function α²F(ω) for the five diborides. The checker recomputes the coupling constant λ and logarithmic average frequency ω_log from this data and scores them against the paper's reported values with appropriate tolerances.
Reported coupling parameters and Tc. The checker compares the Tc values to the paper's Table III using absolute/relative tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The DFT calculations are computationally heavy; the solving agent may use external high-performance compute and must bring the final artifacts to /app/outputs. No wet-lab steps are required.
